content.introduction: The Student Health Center provides comprehensive medical care to all enrolled students. Most services are covered by the student health fee.

sections.title: Services
sections.content:
Medical Services:
- Primary care visits
- Illness and injury treatment
- Physical examinations
- Immunizations
- Allergy injections
- Lab tests and screenings
- X-rays
- Minor procedures

Specialty Services:
- Women's health
- Men's health
- Sports medicine
- Travel health
- Nutrition counseling

sections.title: Hours and Location
sections.content:
Location: Health Services Building

Regular Hours:
Monday-Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Saturday: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM (urgent care)

Summer/Break Hours:
Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM

After-Hours Nurse Line: (555) 123-4567
Available 24/7 for medical advice

sections.title: Appointments
sections.content:
Schedule Online:
1. Log into Student Health Portal
2. Select 'Schedule Appointment'
3. Choose appointment type
4. Select available time
5. Confirm booking

By Phone: (555) 123-4560

Walk-In Clinic:
- For urgent issues
- First-come, first-served
- Wait times vary

sections.title: What to Bring
sections.content:
Required:
- Student ID
- Insurance card (if applicable)
- List of current medications

Helpful:
- Medical history summary
- Vaccination records
- Previous test results
- List of questions

sections.title: Costs
sections.content:
Student Health Fee Covers:
- Office visits
- Basic lab work
- Nurse consultations

Additional Costs:
- Prescriptions
- Specialty referrals
- Extensive lab work
- X-rays and imaging

We accept most insurance. Uninsured students can discuss payment options.

content.conclusion: Your health matters. Don't wait until a small problem becomes big - come in when you're not feeling well.

content.introduction: The Counseling Center provides confidential mental health services to help students navigate the challenges of college life. All services are free.

sections.title: Services Available
sections.content:
Individual Counseling:
- Personal issues
- Academic concerns
- Relationship difficulties
- Anxiety and depression
- Grief and loss
- Identity exploration
- Trauma support

Group Therapy:
- Anxiety management
- Depression support
- Grief groups
- LGBTQ+ support
- International student adjustment

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.content:
Initial Consultation:
1. Call or walk in to schedule
2. Complete intake forms
3. Meet with a counselor (30-45 min)
4. Discuss your needs and options
5. Schedule follow-up as needed

Phone: (555) 123-4575
Location: Wellness Center, Suite 200

sections.title: What to Expect
sections.content:
Confidentiality:
- Sessions are private
- Information not shared without consent
- Limited exceptions for safety
- FERPA and HIPAA protected

Typical Session:
- 50 minutes
- Individual or group format
- Collaborative goal-setting
- Coping skill development

sections.title: Crisis Resources
sections.content:
If you or someone you know is in crisis:

Campus Resources:
- Counseling Center: (555) 123-4575
- Campus Police: (555) 123-4500
- After-Hours Crisis: (555) 123-4576

National Resources:
- 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: Call or text 988
- Crisis Text Line: Text HOME to 741741

In immediate danger? Call 911

sections.title: Self-Help Resources
sections.content:
Wellness Programs:
- Mindfulness Mondays (12pm)
- Stress Busters Fridays (3pm)
- Anxiety workshops (monthly)
- Meditation room (Library 3rd floor)

Apps Available:
- Headspace (free student subscription)
- Calm
- Sanvello

content.conclusion: Taking care of your mental health is just as important as physical health. Reaching out is a sign of strength.
